scripts.validate:data: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const dir='src/data/agency';const states=fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()).map(d=>d.name).sort();if(!states.length){console.error('No state directories in '+dir);process.exit(1)}const bad=states.filter(s=>cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['scripts/agency/validate.mjs',s],{stdio:'inherit'}).status!==0);if(bad.length){console.error('Validation failed for: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('All '+states.length+' states passed validation.')"
scripts.test: npm run test:lib && npm run test:shortlist
